about: des_y3_like/analyze_dps.py. slope: least-squares slope of the DPS posterior mean against the true kappa, per tomographic bin; *_mean and *_sem over the mocks. bias_percent: 100 * (slope_ignored / slope_modelled - 1) per mock (rows) and bin. ks_bias_percent: single-bin Kaiser-Squires expectation 100 * A * sum_l C^{I kappa}_bb / sum_l C^{kappa kappa}_bb over the modes of the grid. wiener_percent: the same change for the tomographic Wiener filter on the 100 held-out maps at the same noise (wiener_reference.py); wiener_deep_percent: at wiener_deep_neff galaxies per arcmin^2 per bin; wiener_single_bin_percent: Wiener filter of one bin at a time (not drawn). leak: slope of (mean_ignored - mean_modelled) against the injected A kappa_IA.
